Presidio is an open-source SDK for detecting, redacting, masking, and anonymizing sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) within text, images, and structured data. It offers a pluggable and customizable framework that supports various recognition methods, including NLP and pattern matching, to help organizations maintain data privacy and compliance.
